content: As of late 2025/2026, Python 3.14 wheel coverage is still catching up: pandas 2.3.3 has 3.14 wheels (some gaps on free-threaded Windows), pyarrow was targeting a 3.14-compatible release around Arrow 22 timed with 3.14's launch, and scikit-learn had NOT shipped 3.14 wheels as of Oct 2025. LightGBM and PuLP wheel status for 3.14 was not confirmed by search and should be verified directly against PyPI before pinning.
